lines: His usage has dipped lately: he played 54% of snaps over his last 3 games, against 58% for the season, and averaged 3.3 targets a game.
He averages 12.0 PPR points over his last 3 games, against 13.4 for the season. Shanahan said he scored on a 70-yard reverse.
Week 12 is vs SEA, which allows the 32nd-most PPR points per game to WRs; the coach said he is healthy but still working back in.
